itemKeys: New level display panel: difficulty selection and dialogue replay are now handled from a single screen, replacing the old level start flow.
Added the Bestiary, with dedicated pages and buttons for each enemy.
Added an age verification step and privacy policy acceptance during profile creation.
You can now delete your account and all of its data directly from the profile panel.
Towers can now be tapped during gameplay through a dedicated area to open their info panel.
New splash screen with animated fade in/out and FMOD logo.
Ratings are now shown on the level display panel and on the victory panel.
Part 2 of the visual overhaul is here: the entire UI has been rebuilt, including main menu, game panel, tower panel, dialogue panel, options, credits and all popups.
Panels, wave counter, stats and dialogues now use smooth animations across the whole game.
Endless mode has been completely rebalanced with a new wave composition and difficulty curve.
Levels 2, 3, 4 and 5 received balance adjustments, and a shooting enemy was added to level 2.
Offline connectivity is now handled properly, with a retry panel during startup operations.
Victory and defeat panels have been reworked in both layout and functionality.
Music and FMOD banks updated, including new music for level 1-4.
Many missing translations added and duplicate ones removed across the whole game.
Fixed a case where the gameplay could get stuck when an enemy was not killed.
Fixed locked towers appearing in the list of placeable towers.
Fixed tower stats not updating correctly after buying a power up.
Fixed the mammoth sound not changing pitch when the game speed was changed.
Fixed Showtime banners being visible when they shouldn't and their position in the tower info panel.
Fixed options sliders not showing their correct starting values and the settings panel scroll.
Fixed login panel translations, back navigation and settings/language reset on logout.
Fixed creating a new guest account after deleting the previous one.
Fixed tutorial bugs, tower shadows and several dialogue and character positioning issues.
Removed the default engine splash screen and unused assets and animations.
